## Description

ISO 10303-21 §11 reserves names beginning with `!` for user-defined entities. Schema-driven readers whose keyword regex is `[A-Z][0-9A-Z_]*` reject them outright instead of treating them as opaque user types.

`#12=!MYCURVE(0.0,0.0,0.0,1.0,$,$,$);`

lex `!`-prefixed identifiers as keywords; reject by schema validation OR pass through as a generic-entity placeholder.
